summary: Current runtime truth is plugin snapshot + WorldModelCache + 8890 daemon + Knowledge Fabric/direct MCP queries. Append-only live packet archives are retired.

components.name: RuneLite plugin
components.purpose: Read-only client telemetry capture and cache population.
components.diskWriting: bounded session manifest/dictionaries only in normal mode; explicit debug modes are retired from the visible UI
components.replacementForOldSystem: Replaces raw live packet archive writes with bounded in-memory cache updates.

components.name: PluginSnapshotEndpoint 8893
components.purpose: Read-only localhost snapshot API for daemon, Knowledge Fabric, and Codex queries.

components.name: WorldModelCache
components.purpose: Fresh loaded-scene object, projection, collision, and camera data.

components.name: 8890 live daemon/context service
components.purpose: In-memory current state, analyzers, Mission Control, action readiness, and bounded overlay state.
components.diskWriting: optional latest-state overlay_debug_state.json only when explicitly enabled
components.replacementForOldSystem: Replaces runtime fallback to live packet archive files.

components.name: Knowledge Fabric
components.purpose: Query-first aggregate state, blocker explanation, data quality, replay, task authoring, and script context.
components.replacementForOldSystem: Replaces grepping stale runtime files for current truth.

components.name: MCP/local query adapter
components.purpose: Read-only Codex/AI inspection and planning access to Knowledge Fabric.
components.replacementForOldSystem: Replaces ad hoc file scraping for live debugging.

components.name: current_debug_context
components.purpose: One compact first query for live status, blocker, candidates, view/pathing, data quality, disk status, and external knowledge.
components.replacementForOldSystem: Replaces searching live packet archives to understand current state.

components.name: Replay/script-authoring/visual debug bundles
components.purpose: Explicit capped evidence capture for offline replay and future script authoring.
components.replacementForOldSystem: Replaces unbounded continuous JSONL packet archives.

components.name: External OSRS knowledge cache
components.purpose: Advisory item/object/NPC/wiki/requirement/location enrichment for explanations and script authoring.
components.replacementForOldSystem: Adds static enrichment without changing live truth.

components.name: Arduino/HumanInputController
components.purpose: Only approved live motor-output path for mouse, keyboard, and camera controls.
components.diskWriting: bounded input_integrity_status.json when monitor is running

components.name: Legacy live packet archive
components.diskWriting: none; runtime must not create live_packets/live-*.ndjson/live-*.jsonl
components.replacementForOldSystem: Use PluginSnapshotEndpoint, WorldModelCache, Knowledge Fabric, replay_scenario, script_authoring_context, and visual_debug_bundle.
